assertions.assertion: Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is coded with CPT 93229
The patient has recurrent episodes of syncope
The patient has transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The diagnoses are R55 and G45.9
The service was ordered to evaluate for underlying arrhythmias or hemodynamic instability contributing to syncopal events and cerebral hypoperfusion
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial letter references the claim for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) being denied
The denial is based on reason code PR-204 indicating the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
The denial letter references the Explanation of Benefits as attached
